label: Shielded — holding the sanctuary doors
injuries: A hairline crack along the left forearm from turning a blade off a grave marker

recentEvents.value: The tomb attendants are past the second door now; only the deepest ledger-vault remains to be emptied.
He holds the doors and speaks over his shoulder to the ancestors: rest easy, he is still between the stranger and their doors.

unresolvedConflicts.value: The intruder presses toward the occupied chambers and will not be reasoned with.

temporaryObjective.value: Hold the doors until every name is carried deep.
